recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, high-key black and white photograph of a female rock musician seated on a white floor, holding an electric guitar vertically. The image features a stark white background and two horizontal, label-like text strips at the top with distressed, sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical guitar neck bisecting the upper half of the frame
High-contrast lighting creating deep shadows against a blown-out white background
Text strips acting as a header bar, balancing the weight of the dark subject below
Rough, tactile textures in the subject's hair and boots contrasting with the smooth white void
coreInvariants: Pure white background with no horizon line
Heavy black shadows with minimal mid-tone detail
Distressed, blocky sans-serif text on colored rectangular strips

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, seated on the floor, occupying the bottom two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark body of the electric guitar in the center-foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top text strips, follow the vertical guitar neck down to the musician's face, and then spread to the textured boots at the bottom corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space surrounding the subject, creating a 'floating' effect.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep Blue and Bright Red (text background strips)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast between black and white; high saturation in the small color accents at the top.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters appear slightly eroded or under-inked
Varying heights for characters within the same word

composition.rotation: slight upward tilt on the left strip

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Uniform style across two different colored background blocks.
graphicDevices: Rectangular color blocks with rough edges

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed weight and bold presence.
Captures the specific 'stamped' look of the text strips.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-contrast black and white photo of a female musician with dark shaggy hair, wearing dark clothing and large furry boots, sitting on a white floor holding a black electric guitar vertically. The background is pure, featureless white. The lighting is harsh, creating deep black shadows and bright white highlights.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two horizontal rectangular strips at the top. The left strip is navy blue, tilted slightly upward, with white distressed condensed sans-serif text. The right strip is red, horizontal, with the same white distressed text style.

verificationChecks: Is the background pure white without any gray tones?
Are the text strips placed at the very top edge?
Is the guitar held vertically in the center?
Does the text have a tactile, stamped quality?

mustRedesign: Specific band name and album title text
Any proprietary logos on the guitar headstock
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the subject's face is visible but high-contrast
Check that the text strips look like physical labels
Verify the boots have a distinct furry/shaggy texture
Confirm the guitar neck is the primary vertical axis
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast monochrome portrait + centered vertical element + top-aligned colored label-style typography.
